description: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) at 10 for different configurations of a dense retrieval system as the number of queries used during inference increases. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and is a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5. The plot includes six lines representing different configurations: "DRP w/o query" (black line with a solid style), "DRP w/ gold" (yellow line with a solid style), "DRP w/ top-1" (green line with a solid style), "DRP w/ bottom-1" (blue line with a solid style), "DRP w/ random" (purple line with a solid style), and "DRP w/ curriculum" (red line with a dashed style). The "DRP w/ gold" line shows a steady increase in MRR as the number of queries increases, starting at approximately 35.0 and ending at around 36.5. The "DRP w/ top-1" line also shows an increase, starting at about 34.5 and ending near 36.0. The "DRP w/ bottom-1" line remains relatively flat, starting and ending around 34.5. The "DRP w/ random" line shows a slight increase, starting at approximately 34.0 and ending just above 34.5. The "DRP w/ curriculum" line shows a slight decline, starting at around 35.0 and ending just below 35.0.
